title: Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34
method: Online adjustment of conformal miscoverage level
dataset: Stock-market volatility and US election-night county vote predictions
evaluation: Sequential local and aggregate coverage under changing conditions
difference: SupplyGuard uses commodity-specific residual windows and clipped date-batch updates on AGMARKNET; original guarantees do not automatically transfer.

authors: Yaniv Romano, Rina Foygel Barber, Chiara Sabatti and Emmanuel Candes
title: With Malice Toward None: Assessing Uncertainty via Equalized Coverage
method: Group-conditional conformal and conformalized quantile-regression comparisons
evaluation: Coverage and length by demographic group; 40 random 80/20 train-test splits
difference: SupplyGuard groups by commodity and evaluates chronological forecasts. Fixed state/commodity calibration already exists in the one-state project and is reused.

title: Conformal prediction interval for dynamic time-series
venue: Proceedings of the 38th ICML, PMLR 139, pp. 11559-11569
dataset: Hourly solar and wind energy series; additional time-series experiments
evaluation: Sequential coverage-width comparisons, including missing-data and multistep settings
difference: SupplyGuard does not implement EnbPI. It compares split and rolling adaptive calibration around common point forecasts.

authors: Spyros Makridakis, Evangelos Spiliotis and Vassilios Assimakopoulos
title: M5 accuracy competition: Results, findings, and conclusions
method: Retail forecasting competition, hierarchical reconciliation and model combinations
evaluation: Separate validation/test phases, 28-day horizon and weighted RMSSE
difference: SupplyGuard predicts wholesale market arrivals one day ahead and reports calibration tradeoffs; it does not infer retail demand or inventory benefits.
